name: Masked Performance
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level bard 1, legendary ninja 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (see text)

EFFECT

Range personal (see text)
Target self
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (disbelief); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Masked performance transforms the audible components required to produce either of your mundane performances with the Perform skill or bardic performances (including language-dependent effects) into one specific background noise that is natural and appropriate for the immediate environment. Those who hear your bardic performance masked in this way remain unaware of its true nature while the bardic performance’s effects remain the same.

For example, you could use this spell to make a bardic performance for distraction, inspire courage, or even suggestion sounds like footsteps on gravel, the buzzing of a bee, the sounds of water from a creek, and so forth.

You choose what your mundane performance or your bardic performance altered by masked performance should sound like at the time of the casting, but it must be a noise that belongs in the immediate environment.

Anyone listening to the performance that makes a successful Will save realizes that the sound has been altered and can hear its true nature.

Material Component: A small bit of whatever naturally makes the sound you’re trying to mimic. For example, a small handful of gravel, a bee’s stinger, and a small flask with water taken from a creek are some of the possible material components that can be used to generate the specific background noise listed above.
